description: Betting Experience Overhaul - Fix parlay submission bug, improve bet display, handle edge cases

userStories.title: Create submit_parlay Edge Function
userStories.description: As a player, I want my parlay bets to be created correctly on the server with shared ticket_id.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/submit_parlay/index.ts Edge Function
Accept request with: legs array (each with event_id, market_id, side, odds), stake, player_id, bookie_id, combined_odds, idempotency_key
Generate single ticket_id shared by all legs
Insert one bet record per leg with is_parlay: true, parlay_legs: N (total legs count)
All inserts in single transaction (all succeed or all fail)
Return array of created bet records with shared ticket_id
Validate all events are not locked before inserting
Check idempotency to prevent duplicate submissions
Typecheck passes
